QuestInfo.name: The So-called Black Wings
QuestInfo.0: You beat a mysterious stranger in a duel, but something he said is bugging you. Ask #b#p1012100##k if she knows anything about it.
QuestInfo.1: After hearing the mysterious stranger's description, #p1012100# thinks he was with the #rBlack Wings#k. Still, he sounded like he's known about you a long time, and the Black Wings only just found out about you.\r\n\r\nWhat else could this man know? Maybe you should investigate #m102000000# and see what turns up. #b#p1022002##k seems to have sharp eyes for these things, so try asking him.
QuestInfo.2: You met with #p1022002# in #m102000000# and asked if he'd seen the mysterious stranger. He had.

0.0: Your Highness! You're looking stronger every time I see you! How may I serve?\r\n#L0##b(Tell her about the strange challenge and #p1204020#.)#l\n#k
0.1: How strange. I don't think many people know who you really are... Tell me, what was he wearing?\r\n#L0##bHe had a bamboo hat and a cloth covering his face. His clothes look like they came from Mu Lung. His speech was old, but not from the same period I come from. He was all in black, and there was a wing decoration...#l\n#k
0.2: Then he must be with the #rBlack Wings#k! You've got them scared, Your Highness!\r\n#L0##bI'm not so sure. They can't know that much about me, but #p1204020# talked like he knew me. There's something else going on here.#l\n#k
0.3: The Black Wings have agents all over Maple World. They must be up to something. With your leave, I'll find them and stop them. Your Majesty, please hide yourself away in the village for now.\r\n#L0##bYou would have me hide while my people are in danger? You overstep your bounds, Athena Pierce!#l\n#k
0.4: I'm sorry! I only... I worry for your safety, Your Highness. I can see you're set on seeing this through yourself, however. In that case, may I suggest starting your investigation back in #m102000000#?

yes.0: Perhaps that man, #b#p1022002##k, who's training in #b#m102000000##k has seen something.

1.0: ...What is it? Don't bother me.\r\n#L0##bHave you seen anyone suspicious around here? (You give a detailed description of what #p1204020# looks like.)#l\n#k

npc.0: #b#p1022002##k in #b#m102000000##k is probably your best bet... Your Highness.
